commit 84ed7b86d1565ec55644c0a04e05f60e4432c90c
Author:     Rob Lemley <rob@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Sat Jun 15 00:23:01 2024 +0000
Commit:     Rob Lemley <rob@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Sat Jun 15 00:23:01 2024 +0000

    Bug 1902688 - Port bug 1898177: Set MOZ_APP_VENDOR to Mozilla. r=dandarnell
    
    Also set MOZ_APP_PROFILE to "thunderbird" to avoid problems with it
    moving.
    Other issues will come up. See the notes in the bug. This patch will
    hopefully be backed out.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D213791

diff --git a/mail/confvars.sh b/mail/confvars.sh
index ebbd75c598f..334a9cdeb68 100755
--- a/mail/confvars.sh
+++ b/mail/confvars.sh
@@ -4,6 +4,7 @@
 # file, You can obtain one at http://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/.
 
 MOZ_APP_NAME=thunderbird
+MOZ_APP_PROFILE=thunderbird
 
 if test "$OS_ARCH" = "WINNT"; then
   if ! test "$HAVE_64BIT_BUILD"; then
diff --git a/mail/moz.configure b/mail/moz.configure
index 12a57dc8511..733cb96aed8 100644
--- a/mail/moz.configure
+++ b/mail/moz.configure
@@ -15,6 +15,7 @@ imply_option("MOZ_REQUIRE_SIGNING", False)
 imply_option("MOZ_SERVICES_SYNC", True)
 
 imply_option("MOZ_APP_ID", "{3550f703-e582-4d05-9a08-453d09bdfdc6}")
+imply_option("MOZ_APP_VENDOR", "Mozilla")
 
 @depends(target_is_windows, target_has_linux_kernel)
 def bundled_fonts(is_windows, is_linux):
